measurement_definitions.length: Total bounding distance along longitudinal Z axis from heel_back (Z=0.0) to toe_tip (Z=265.0): length = 265.0 mm exactly.
measurement_definitions.width: Total transverse distance along X axis between ball_medial (X=+49.0) and ball_lateral (X=-49.0): width = 98.0 mm exactly.
measurement_definitions.measurement_type: Anatomical surface landmark coordinates for calibrated virtual shoe fitting.

coordinate_system.up_axis: +Y (floor normal / height above ground; sole contact plane at Y=0.0)

reflection_rule.rotation_reflection_so3: R_left = S * R_right * S, where S = diag(-1, 1, 1). Preserves det(R) = +1 in SO(3).

lateral_axis_meaning: +X is medial (big-toe side), -X is lateral (pinky-toe side)

0.name: toe_tip
0.description: Most anterior point of foot outline

1.name: toe_ground
1.description: Front ground contact point of sole

2.name: heel_back
2.description: Most posterior point of heel outline (Z bound = 0.0)

3.name: heel_ground
3.description: Back ground contact point of heel

6.name: ball_top
6.description: Top of forefoot above ball line

7.name: instep_top
7.description: Apex of instep (highest dorsal arch point)

8.name: arch_medial
8.description: Deepest point of medial longitudinal arch

9.name: midfoot_lateral
9.description: Lateral midfoot border at 5th metatarsal base

10.name: malleolus_medial
10.description: Center of medial malleolus (inner ankle bone)

11.name: malleolus_lateral
11.description: Center of lateral malleolus (outer ankle bone)

12.name: ankle_center
12.description: Midpoint between medial and lateral malleoli

14.name: achilles
14.description: Posterior curve of Achilles tendon level with ankle center

15.name: shin_mid
15.description: Leg centerline, exactly 120 mm proximal to ankle_center
